services.name: Bike Rentals
services.desc: Discover the thrill of the Rockies with Granby Ranch’s guided e-bike tours! Perfect for riders of all levels, our e-bikes make it easy to cruise up scenic trails and soak in breathtaking mountain views. Guests must be 5′ or taller in order to properly use rental equipment. Due to safety limitations set by the bike part manufacturers, participants should weight 250 pounds or less. E-Bike tours are a great experience with an expert Granby Ranch guide leading you through the beautiful trails lined with Aspens.
